en_definition: to put something with something else so there is more
example_meaning_en: Add your name to the list.
example_meaning_vi: Hãy thêm tên của bạn vào danh sách.
example_usage_en: Add a little milk to the coffee.
example_usage_vi: Thêm một ít sữa vào cà phê.
usage_note: Common pattern: add something to something.

en_definition: the details that show where a person lives or where a place is
example_meaning_en: Please write your address on the form.
example_meaning_vi: Vui lòng viết địa chỉ của bạn vào biểu mẫu.
example_usage_en: Send the photo to my email address.
example_usage_vi: Hãy gửi bức ảnh đến địa chỉ email của tôi.
usage_note: Common combinations include home address and email address.

en_definition: a person who is fully grown
example_meaning_en: Two adults are waiting outside.
example_meaning_vi: Hai người lớn đang đợi bên ngoài.
example_usage_en: Children must come with an adult.
example_usage_vi: Trẻ em phải đi cùng một người lớn.
usage_note: Adult is a countable noun: an adult, two adults.

en_definition: an opinion about what someone should do
example_meaning_en: Her advice helped me choose a course.
example_meaning_vi: Lời khuyên của cô ấy giúp tôi chọn khóa học.
example_usage_en: Can you give me some advice?
example_usage_vi: Bạn có thể cho tôi một vài lời khuyên không?
usage_note: Advice is uncountable; say some advice, not an advice.

en_definition: feeling fear or worry
example_meaning_en: The child is afraid of the dark.
example_meaning_vi: Đứa trẻ sợ bóng tối.
example_usage_en: I'm afraid to ask that question.
example_usage_vi: Tôi ngại hỏi câu đó.
usage_note: Use afraid of + noun or afraid to + verb.

en_definition: later than someone or something
example_meaning_en: We went home after dinner.
example_meaning_vi: Chúng tôi về nhà sau bữa tối.
example_usage_en: Meet me after class.
example_usage_vi: Hãy gặp tôi sau giờ học.
usage_note: After is followed by a noun or an -ing form.

en_definition: the part of the day between noon and evening
example_meaning_en: I have a class this afternoon.
example_meaning_vi: Tôi có một lớp học vào chiều nay.
example_usage_en: She works in the afternoon.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy làm việc vào buổi chiều.
usage_note: Say this afternoon, but in the afternoon.

en_definition: one more time
example_meaning_en: Please say that again.
example_meaning_vi: Vui lòng nói lại điều đó.
example_usage_en: It is good to see you again.
example_usage_vi: Thật vui khi lại gặp bạn.
usage_note: Again usually comes after the object or at the end.

en_definition: the number of years someone has lived
example_meaning_en: What is your age?
example_meaning_vi: Bạn bao nhiêu tuổi?
example_usage_en: Children of all ages can join.
example_usage_vi: Trẻ em ở mọi độ tuổi đều có thể tham gia.
usage_note: At the age of introduces a specific age.

en_definition: before now, used with a period of time
example_meaning_en: We met two years ago.
example_meaning_vi: Chúng tôi gặp nhau hai năm trước.
example_usage_en: She left a few minutes ago.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy rời đi vài phút trước.
usage_note: Ago follows a length of time.

en_definition: to have the same opinion or accept a suggestion
example_meaning_en: I agree with you.
example_meaning_vi: Tôi đồng ý với bạn.
example_usage_en: They agreed to meet at six.
example_usage_vi: Họ đồng ý gặp nhau lúc sáu giờ.
usage_note: Use agree with a person and agree to do something.

en_definition: the mixture of gases that people and animals breathe
example_meaning_en: Open the window and let in some fresh air.
example_meaning_vi: Mở cửa sổ để không khí trong lành vào.
example_usage_en: The mountain air is cool and clean.
example_usage_vi: Không khí trên núi mát mẻ và trong lành.
usage_note: Air is usually uncountable.

en_definition: a place where airplanes arrive and leave
example_meaning_en: The airport is busy this morning.
example_meaning_vi: Sân bay sáng nay rất đông.
example_usage_en: We arrived at the airport early.
example_usage_vi: Chúng tôi đến sân bay sớm.
usage_note: Use arrive at the airport.

en_definition: the whole number or amount of people or things
example_meaning_en: All the windows are open.
example_meaning_vi: Tất cả cửa sổ đều đang mở.
example_usage_en: We all enjoyed the movie.
example_usage_vi: Tất cả chúng tôi đều thích bộ phim.
usage_note: All can come before a noun or after a subject pronoun.

en_definition: in addition
example_meaning_en: She speaks English and also French.
example_meaning_vi: Cô ấy nói tiếng Anh và cả tiếng Pháp.
example_usage_en: He is kind, and he is also very patient.
example_usage_vi: Anh ấy tốt bụng và cũng rất kiên nhẫn.
usage_note: Also normally comes before the main verb but after be.

en_definition: at all times or every time
example_meaning_en: He always drinks water with lunch.
example_meaning_vi: Anh ấy luôn uống nước vào bữa trưa.
example_usage_en: She is always on time.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy luôn đúng giờ.
usage_note: Always comes before most verbs but after be.

en_definition: very surprising or extremely good
example_meaning_en: The view from the hill is amazing.
example_meaning_vi: Quang cảnh từ ngọn đồi thật tuyệt vời.
example_usage_en: We had an amazing time at the beach.
example_usage_vi: Chúng tôi đã có khoảng thời gian tuyệt vời ở bãi biển.
usage_note: Amazing describes the thing that causes the feeling.

en_definition: used to join words, phrases, or ideas
example_meaning_en: I bought bread and cheese.
example_meaning_vi: Tôi mua bánh mì và phô mai.
example_usage_en: She opened the door and walked inside.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy mở cửa rồi bước vào trong.
usage_note: And joins items or actions of equal importance.

en_definition: feeling strong displeasure
example_meaning_en: He was angry about the mistake.
example_meaning_vi: Anh ấy tức giận về lỗi đó.
example_usage_en: Please don't be angry with me.
example_usage_vi: Xin đừng giận tôi.
usage_note: Use angry with a person and angry about something.

en_definition: a living creature that is not a plant
example_meaning_en: A dolphin is an intelligent animal.
example_meaning_vi: Cá heo là một loài động vật thông minh.
example_usage_en: Many animals live in this forest.
example_usage_vi: Nhiều loài động vật sống trong khu rừng này.
usage_note: Animal is countable.

en_definition: one more person or thing, or a different one
example_meaning_en: Can I have another cup of tea?
example_meaning_vi: Tôi có thể uống thêm một tách trà không?
example_usage_en: This pen is broken; give me another.
example_usage_vi: Cây bút này hỏng rồi; đưa tôi cây khác nhé.
usage_note: Another can stand before a singular noun or alone as a pronoun.

en_definition: something said or written in reply, or to reply
example_meaning_en: I know the answer to this question.
example_meaning_vi: Tôi biết câu trả lời cho câu hỏi này.
example_usage_en: Please answer the phone.
example_usage_vi: Vui lòng nghe điện thoại.
usage_note: Use the answer to a question; answer does not need to before an object.

en_definition: one or some, without saying exactly which or how many
example_meaning_en: Do you have any questions?
example_meaning_vi: Bạn có câu hỏi nào không?
example_usage_en: I don't have any money with me.
example_usage_vi: Tôi không mang theo chút tiền nào.
usage_note: Any is common in questions and negative sentences.

en_definition: any person
example_meaning_en: Does anyone know her name?
example_meaning_vi: Có ai biết tên cô ấy không?
example_usage_en: Anyone can use this computer.
example_usage_vi: Bất kỳ ai cũng có thể dùng máy tính này.
usage_note: Anyone takes a singular verb.

vi_meaning: bất kỳ điều gì; thứ gì đó
en_definition: any thing or event
example_meaning_en: Is there anything in the box?
example_meaning_vi: Có thứ gì trong hộp không?
example_usage_en: You can ask me anything.
example_usage_vi: Bạn có thể hỏi tôi bất cứ điều gì.
usage_note: Anything takes a singular verb.

en_definition: a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a building
example_meaning_en: Their apartment has two bedrooms.
example_meaning_vi: Căn hộ của họ có hai phòng ngủ.
example_usage_en: She lives in a small apartment downtown.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy sống trong một căn hộ nhỏ ở trung tâm thành phố.
usage_note: Use live in an apartment.

en_definition: a round fruit with red, green, or yellow skin
example_meaning_en: He ate an apple after lunch.
example_meaning_vi: Anh ấy ăn một quả táo sau bữa trưa.
example_usage_en: Would you like a slice of apple?
example_usage_vi: Bạn có muốn một lát táo không?
usage_note: Apple is countable; use an before it.

en_definition: the fourth month of the year
example_meaning_en: My course starts in April.
example_meaning_vi: Khóa học của tôi bắt đầu vào tháng Tư.
example_usage_en: Her birthday is on April 12.
example_usage_vi: Sinh nhật của cô ấy là ngày 12 tháng Tư.
usage_note: Use in with a month and on with a full date.

en_definition: a particular part of a place
example_meaning_en: This area is quiet at night.
example_meaning_vi: Khu vực này yên tĩnh vào ban đêm.
example_usage_en: There is a seating area near the window.
example_usage_vi: Có một khu vực chỗ ngồi gần cửa sổ.
usage_note: Area is countable when referring to a particular place.

en_definition: the part of the body from the shoulder to the hand
example_meaning_en: She carried the baby in her arms.
example_meaning_vi: Cô ấy bế em bé trong vòng tay.
example_usage_en: He put his arm around his brother.
example_usage_vi: Anh ấy vòng tay ôm em trai mình.
usage_note: Common phrases include in your arms and put an arm around someone.

en_definition: in a circle or on every side of something
example_meaning_en: We sat around the table.
example_meaning_vi: Chúng tôi ngồi quanh bàn.
example_usage_en: She looked around but saw nobody.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy nhìn quanh nhưng không thấy ai.
usage_note: Around can be a preposition or an adverb without an object.

en_definition: to reach a place
example_meaning_en: The train arrived late.
example_meaning_vi: Tàu đến muộn.
example_usage_en: We arrived in Hanoi at noon.
example_usage_vi: Chúng tôi đến Hà Nội vào buổi trưa.
usage_note: Use arrive in for cities/countries and arrive at for smaller places.

en_definition: the creation of beautiful or meaningful objects and images
example_meaning_en: Modern art can be very colorful.
example_meaning_vi: Nghệ thuật hiện đại có thể rất nhiều màu sắc.
example_usage_en: She studies art at college.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy học nghệ thuật ở trường cao đẳng.
usage_note: Art is usually uncountable when it means the subject.

en_definition: a piece of writing in a newspaper, magazine, or website
example_meaning_en: I read an article about healthy food.
example_meaning_vi: Tôi đọc một bài viết về thức ăn lành mạnh.
example_usage_en: She wrote an article for the school blog.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy viết một bài cho blog của trường.
usage_note: Use an article about a topic and an article for a publication.

en_definition: a person who creates art
example_meaning_en: The artist painted a picture of the sea.
example_meaning_vi: Người nghệ sĩ vẽ một bức tranh về biển.
example_usage_en: He works as an artist in the city.
example_usage_vi: Anh ấy làm nghệ sĩ trong thành phố.
usage_note: Work as + job names a person's occupation.

en_definition: in the role or function of someone or something
example_meaning_en: She works as a teacher.
example_meaning_vi: Cô ấy làm giáo viên.
example_usage_en: Use this box as a table.
example_usage_vi: Hãy dùng chiếc hộp này làm bàn.
usage_note: As introduces a role or function.

en_definition: to speak or write to get information or request something
example_meaning_en: I asked her name.
example_meaning_vi: Tôi hỏi tên cô ấy.
example_usage_en: Ask your teacher for help.
example_usage_vi: Hãy nhờ giáo viên giúp đỡ.
usage_note: Use ask someone a question and ask someone for something.

en_definition: used to show an exact place or time
example_meaning_en: Meet me at the station.
example_meaning_vi: Gặp tôi tại nhà ga nhé.
example_usage_en: The class starts at nine o'clock.
example_usage_vi: Lớp học bắt đầu lúc chín giờ.
usage_note: Use at for exact places and clock times.

en_definition: the eighth month of the year
example_meaning_en: It is very hot here in August.
example_meaning_vi: Ở đây rất nóng vào tháng Tám.
example_usage_en: The festival begins on August 5.
example_usage_vi: Lễ hội bắt đầu vào ngày 5 tháng Tám.
usage_note: Use in with a month and on with a full date.

en_definition: the sister of your mother or father, or the wife of your uncle
example_meaning_en: My aunt lives near us.
example_meaning_vi: Dì tôi sống gần nhà chúng tôi.
example_usage_en: We are visiting Aunt Mai this weekend.
example_usage_vi: Cuối tuần này chúng tôi sẽ thăm dì Mai.
usage_note: Capitalize Aunt when it is used with a person's name.

en_definition: to or at another place
example_meaning_en: The school is two kilometers away.
example_meaning_vi: Trường học cách đây hai ki-lô-mét.
example_usage_en: Please put your phone away during class.
example_usage_vi: Vui lòng cất điện thoại trong giờ học.
usage_note: Put something away means return it to its proper place.

en_definition: extremely good or impressive
example_meaning_en: The concert was awesome.
example_meaning_vi: Buổi hòa nhạc thật tuyệt vời.
example_usage_en: You did an awesome job on the project.
example_usage_vi: Bạn đã làm dự án rất xuất sắc.
usage_note: Awesome is informal and common in conversation.

en_definition: a very young child or animal
example_meaning_en: The baby is sleeping.
example_meaning_vi: Em bé đang ngủ.
example_usage_en: They have a six-month-old baby.
example_usage_vi: Họ có một em bé sáu tháng tuổi.
usage_note: Baby is countable; the plural is babies.

en_definition: the rear part, or toward an earlier place or condition
example_meaning_en: The garden is at the back of the house.
example_meaning_vi: Khu vườn ở phía sau ngôi nhà.
example_usage_en: I'll call you back after lunch.
example_usage_vi: Tôi sẽ gọi lại cho bạn sau bữa trưa.
usage_note: Call someone back means return a phone call.

en_definition: of poor quality, unpleasant, or harmful
example_meaning_en: The weather is bad today.
example_meaning_vi: Thời tiết hôm nay xấu.
example_usage_en: Smoking is bad for your health.
example_usage_vi: Hút thuốc có hại cho sức khỏe.
usage_note: Use bad for to describe something harmful.

en_definition: a container made of flexible material used for carrying things
example_meaning_en: Her books are in the bag.
example_meaning_vi: Sách của cô ấy ở trong túi.
example_usage_en: He packed a bag for the weekend.
example_usage_vi: Anh ấy xếp một túi đồ cho cuối tuần.
usage_note: Common phrases include a shopping bag and pack a bag.

en_definition: a round object used in games and sports
example_meaning_en: The children kicked the ball.
example_meaning_vi: Bọn trẻ đá quả bóng.
example_usage_en: Throw the ball to me.
example_usage_vi: Ném bóng cho tôi.
usage_note: Common verbs with ball are throw, catch, and kick.

en_definition: a long curved fruit with yellow skin
example_meaning_en: She put a banana in her lunch box.
example_meaning_vi: Cô ấy đặt một quả chuối vào hộp cơm trưa.
example_usage_en: I made a banana smoothie.
example_usage_vi: Tôi làm một ly sinh tố chuối.
usage_note: Banana is countable; banana can also describe a flavor or ingredient.

en_definition: a group of musicians who perform together
example_meaning_en: The band played three songs.
example_meaning_vi: Ban nhạc đã chơi ba bài hát.
example_usage_en: My brother plays in a rock band.
example_usage_vi: Anh trai tôi chơi trong một ban nhạc rock.
usage_note: Use play in a band for membership.

en_definition: a business that keeps and lends money
example_meaning_en: The bank closes at five.
example_meaning_vi: Ngân hàng đóng cửa lúc năm giờ.
example_usage_en: I need to take some money out of the bank.
example_usage_vi: Tôi cần rút một ít tiền từ ngân hàng.
usage_note: This card uses the money sense of bank.

en_definition: a place or counter where drinks are served
example_meaning_en: We met at a small bar near the hotel.
example_meaning_vi: Chúng tôi gặp nhau tại một quán bar nhỏ gần khách sạn.
example_usage_en: He ordered water at the bar.
example_usage_vi: Anh ấy gọi nước tại quầy.
usage_note: At the bar can mean at the serving counter.

en_definition: a game in which players hit a ball with a bat and run around bases
example_meaning_en: They play baseball after school.
example_meaning_vi: Họ chơi bóng chày sau giờ học.
example_usage_en: He is on the school baseball team.
example_usage_vi: Cậu ấy ở trong đội bóng chày của trường.
usage_note: Use play baseball without an article.

en_definition: a game in which players throw a ball through a high ring
example_meaning_en: Basketball is popular at our school.
example_meaning_vi: Bóng rổ phổ biến ở trường chúng tôi.
example_usage_en: She plays basketball twice a week.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy chơi bóng rổ hai lần một tuần.
usage_note: Use play basketball without an article.

en_definition: the act of washing your body in water, or the water used for it
example_meaning_en: The child is having a bath.
example_meaning_vi: Đứa trẻ đang tắm.
example_usage_en: I take a warm bath before bed.
example_usage_vi: Tôi tắm nước ấm trước khi ngủ.
usage_note: Have a bath and take a bath are both common.

en_definition: a room containing a toilet, sink, and often a bath or shower
example_meaning_en: The bathroom is next to the bedroom.
example_meaning_vi: Phòng tắm ở cạnh phòng ngủ.
example_usage_en: May I use your bathroom?
example_usage_vi: Tôi có thể dùng nhà vệ sinh của bạn không?
usage_note: In American English, bathroom can politely mean toilet.

en_definition: the basic verb used to describe identity, condition, or location
example_meaning_en: I want to be a doctor.
example_meaning_vi: Tôi muốn trở thành bác sĩ.
example_usage_en: Be careful on the stairs.
example_usage_vi: Hãy cẩn thận trên cầu thang.
usage_note: Forms of be include am, is, are, was, and were.

en_definition: a sandy or stony area beside the sea or a lake
example_meaning_en: We walked along the beach.
example_meaning_vi: Chúng tôi đi bộ dọc bãi biển.
example_usage_en: They spent the day at the beach.
example_usage_vi: Họ dành cả ngày ở bãi biển.
usage_note: Use at the beach for being there and on the beach for the surface.

en_definition: very attractive or pleasant to see
example_meaning_en: The garden is beautiful in spring.
example_meaning_vi: Khu vườn rất đẹp vào mùa xuân.
example_usage_en: What a beautiful day!
example_usage_vi: Thật là một ngày đẹp trời!
usage_note: Beautiful can describe people, places, things, or experiences.

en_definition: for the reason that
example_meaning_en: We stayed inside because it was raining.
example_meaning_vi: Chúng tôi ở trong nhà vì trời mưa.
example_usage_en: She smiled because she was happy.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy mỉm cười vì vui.
usage_note: Because introduces a clause with a subject and verb.

en_definition: to begin to be something
example_meaning_en: The sky became dark.
example_meaning_vi: Bầu trời trở nên tối.
example_usage_en: He wants to become a teacher.
example_usage_vi: Anh ấy muốn trở thành giáo viên.
usage_note: Become is followed by a noun or adjective.

en_definition: a piece of furniture used for sleeping
example_meaning_en: The cat is under the bed.
example_meaning_vi: Con mèo ở dưới gầm giường.
example_usage_en: I usually go to bed at eleven.
example_usage_vi: Tôi thường đi ngủ lúc mười một giờ.
usage_note: Go to bed means begin sleeping and normally has no article.

en_definition: a room used mainly for sleeping
example_meaning_en: Her bedroom has a large window.
example_meaning_vi: Phòng ngủ của cô ấy có một cửa sổ lớn.
example_usage_en: There are two bedrooms upstairs.
example_usage_vi: Có hai phòng ngủ ở tầng trên.
usage_note: Bedroom is countable.

en_definition: an alcoholic drink made from grain
example_meaning_en: He ordered a glass of beer.
example_meaning_vi: Anh ấy gọi một ly bia.
example_usage_en: Would you like a beer?
example_usage_vi: Bạn có muốn một ly bia không?
usage_note: Beer is uncountable for the drink, but a beer means one serving.

en_definition: earlier than someone or something
example_meaning_en: Wash your hands before dinner.
example_meaning_vi: Hãy rửa tay trước bữa tối.
example_usage_en: We arrived before eight o'clock.
example_usage_vi: Chúng tôi đến trước tám giờ.
usage_note: Before can introduce a noun, time, or -ing form.

en_definition: to start happening or doing something
example_meaning_en: The movie begins at seven.
example_meaning_vi: Bộ phim bắt đầu lúc bảy giờ.
example_usage_en: She began to learn English last year.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy bắt đầu học tiếng Anh năm ngoái.
usage_note: Begin can be followed by to + verb or an -ing form.

en_definition: the first part of an event, story, or period
example_meaning_en: The beginning of the movie was funny.
example_meaning_vi: Phần đầu bộ phim rất vui.
example_usage_en: Let's start from the beginning.
example_usage_vi: Hãy bắt đầu lại từ đầu.
usage_note: Use the beginning of something.

en_definition: at or toward the back of someone or something
example_meaning_en: The car is behind the bus.
example_meaning_vi: Chiếc xe hơi ở sau xe buýt.
example_usage_en: She looked behind but saw nobody.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy nhìn ra phía sau nhưng không thấy ai.
usage_note: Behind can be followed by an object or used alone.

en_definition: to think that something is true
example_meaning_en: I believe your story.
example_meaning_vi: Tôi tin câu chuyện của bạn.
example_usage_en: Do you believe in ghosts?
example_usage_vi: Bạn có tin vào ma không?
usage_note: Believe someone means accept their words; believe in means accept that something exists.

en_definition: in or to a lower position than something
example_meaning_en: The temperature fell below zero.
example_meaning_vi: Nhiệt độ giảm xuống dưới không.
example_usage_en: Please read the note below.
example_usage_vi: Vui lòng đọc ghi chú bên dưới.
usage_note: Below can be a preposition or an adverb.

en_definition: of the highest quality or level
example_meaning_en: This is the best restaurant in town.
example_meaning_vi: Đây là nhà hàng tốt nhất trong thị trấn.
example_usage_en: Try your best in the test.
example_usage_vi: Hãy cố gắng hết sức trong bài kiểm tra.
usage_note: Best is the superlative form of good.

en_definition: of higher quality or more suitable
example_meaning_en: This book is better than that one.
example_meaning_vi: Cuốn sách này hay hơn cuốn kia.
example_usage_en: I feel much better today.
example_usage_vi: Hôm nay tôi cảm thấy khỏe hơn nhiều.
usage_note: Better is the comparative form of good; use better than for comparison.

en_definition: in the space separating two people, places, times, or things
example_meaning_en: The bank is between the cafe and the hotel.
example_meaning_vi: Ngân hàng nằm giữa quán cà phê và khách sạn.
example_usage_en: Choose between the blue shirt and the black one.
example_usage_vi: Hãy chọn giữa áo xanh và áo đen.
usage_note: Between commonly connects two alternatives with and.

en_definition: a vehicle with two wheels that you move by pushing pedals
example_meaning_en: She rides her bicycle to school.
example_meaning_vi: Cô ấy đi xe đạp đến trường.
example_usage_en: He came by bicycle.
example_usage_vi: Anh ấy đến bằng xe đạp.
usage_note: Ride a bicycle, but travel by bicycle.

en_definition: large in size or amount
example_meaning_en: They live in a big house.
example_meaning_vi: Họ sống trong một ngôi nhà lớn.
example_usage_en: Moving abroad was a big decision.
example_usage_vi: Chuyển ra nước ngoài là một quyết định lớn.
usage_note: Big can describe physical size or importance.

en_definition: a bicycle
example_meaning_en: My bike is outside.
example_meaning_vi: Xe đạp của tôi ở bên ngoài.
example_usage_en: We went for a bike ride.
example_usage_vi: Chúng tôi đi đạp xe.
usage_note: Bike is the common informal word for bicycle.

en_definition: a written statement of money owed, or a piece of paper money
example_meaning_en: The electricity bill arrived today.
example_meaning_vi: Hóa đơn tiền điện đến hôm nay.
example_usage_en: Can we have the bill, please?
example_usage_vi: Cho chúng tôi xin hóa đơn được không?
usage_note: In a restaurant, bill is common; American English also uses check.

en_definition: an animal with feathers, wings, and a beak
example_meaning_en: A small bird landed on the wall.
example_meaning_vi: Một con chim nhỏ đậu trên tường.
example_usage_en: We heard birds singing in the trees.
example_usage_vi: Chúng tôi nghe tiếng chim hót trên cây.
usage_note: Bird is countable.

en_definition: the day each year that marks when someone was born
example_meaning_en: Today is my birthday.
example_meaning_vi: Hôm nay là sinh nhật của tôi.
example_usage_en: We bought her a birthday cake.
example_usage_vi: Chúng tôi mua cho cô ấy một chiếc bánh sinh nhật.
usage_note: Birthday often modifies nouns: birthday party, card, or cake.

en_definition: the darkest color, or having that color
example_meaning_en: He is wearing a black coat.
example_meaning_vi: Anh ấy đang mặc một chiếc áo khoác đen.
example_usage_en: The photo is in black and white.
example_usage_vi: Bức ảnh có màu đen trắng.
usage_note: Black can be an adjective or a noun naming the color.

en_definition: a website or page where someone regularly posts writing or pictures
example_meaning_en: She writes a travel blog.
example_meaning_vi: Cô ấy viết một blog du lịch.
example_usage_en: I posted the recipe on my blog.
example_usage_vi: Tôi đăng công thức lên blog của mình.
usage_note: Write a blog, but post something on a blog.

en_definition: having pale yellow hair
example_meaning_en: The child has blond hair.
example_meaning_vi: Đứa trẻ có mái tóc vàng hoe.
example_usage_en: He is tall and blond.
example_usage_vi: Anh ấy cao và có tóc vàng.
usage_note: Blond can describe a person or their hair.

en_definition: the color of a clear sky, or having that color
example_meaning_en: She wore a blue dress.
example_meaning_vi: Cô ấy mặc một chiếc váy xanh dương.
example_usage_en: Blue is my favorite color.
example_usage_vi: Xanh dương là màu yêu thích của tôi.
usage_note: Blue can be an adjective or a noun naming the color.

en_definition: a small vehicle used for traveling on water
example_meaning_en: The boat is on the lake.
example_meaning_vi: Chiếc thuyền ở trên hồ.
example_usage_en: We went across the river by boat.
example_usage_vi: Chúng tôi qua sông bằng thuyền.
usage_note: Travel by boat, but get on or off a boat.

en_definition: the whole physical form of a person or animal
example_meaning_en: Exercise is good for your body.
example_meaning_vi: Tập thể dục tốt cho cơ thể bạn.
example_usage_en: The human body needs water.
example_usage_vi: Cơ thể con người cần nước.
usage_note: Body is countable; the plural is bodies.

en_definition: a set of printed or digital pages containing writing or pictures
example_meaning_en: This book is easy to read.
example_meaning_vi: Cuốn sách này dễ đọc.
example_usage_en: I borrowed a book from the library.
example_usage_vi: Tôi mượn một cuốn sách từ thư viện.
usage_note: Read a book; a book about something describes its topic.

en_definition: a strong shoe that covers the foot and part of the leg
example_meaning_en: My boots are wet.
example_meaning_vi: Đôi ủng của tôi bị ướt.
example_usage_en: She put on her walking boots.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy mang đôi giày đi bộ.
usage_note: Boot is often used in the plural for a pair.

en_definition: feeling tired and unhappy because something is not interesting
example_meaning_en: The children are bored at home.
example_meaning_vi: Bọn trẻ cảm thấy chán ở nhà.
example_usage_en: I'm bored with this game.
example_usage_vi: Tôi chán trò chơi này rồi.
usage_note: A person is bored; a thing is boring.

en_definition: not interesting or exciting
example_meaning_en: The lesson was boring.
example_meaning_vi: Bài học thật nhàm chán.
example_usage_en: Doing the same thing every day is boring.
example_usage_vi: Làm cùng một việc mỗi ngày thật chán.
usage_note: A thing is boring; a person who feels this way is bored.

en_definition: brought into life by birth
example_meaning_en: She was born in 2005.
example_meaning_vi: Cô ấy sinh năm 2005.
example_usage_en: He was born in Vietnam but grew up in Canada.
example_usage_vi: Anh ấy sinh ra ở Việt Nam nhưng lớn lên tại Canada.
usage_note: Born is normally used with be: was born in a place or on a date.

en_definition: used to refer to two people or things together
example_meaning_en: Both answers are correct.
example_meaning_vi: Cả hai câu trả lời đều đúng.
example_usage_en: We both enjoy cooking.
example_usage_vi: Cả hai chúng tôi đều thích nấu ăn.
usage_note: Both can come before a plural noun or after a subject pronoun.

en_definition: a container with a narrow top, usually for liquids
example_meaning_en: There is a bottle of water on the desk.
example_meaning_vi: Có một chai nước trên bàn.
example_usage_en: Please put the milk bottle in the fridge.
example_usage_vi: Vui lòng đặt chai sữa vào tủ lạnh.
usage_note: Use a bottle of + liquid to describe an amount.

en_definition: a container with flat sides, usually square or rectangular
example_meaning_en: The shoes are in a box.
example_meaning_vi: Đôi giày ở trong hộp.
example_usage_en: She gave me a box of chocolates.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy tặng tôi một hộp sô-cô-la.
usage_note: Use a box of to describe a container and its contents.

en_definition: a male child or young male person
example_meaning_en: The boy is playing with a ball.
example_meaning_vi: Cậu bé đang chơi bóng.
example_usage_en: They have two boys and one girl.
example_usage_vi: Họ có hai con trai và một con gái.
usage_note: Boy is countable.

en_definition: a male person with whom someone has a romantic relationship
example_meaning_en: Her boyfriend works at the airport.
example_meaning_vi: Bạn trai của cô ấy làm việc ở sân bay.
example_usage_en: She went to the concert with her boyfriend.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy đi xem hòa nhạc cùng bạn trai.
usage_note: Boyfriend is countable.

en_definition: food made by baking a mixture of flour and water
example_meaning_en: We bought fresh bread this morning.
example_meaning_vi: Chúng tôi mua bánh mì tươi sáng nay.
example_usage_en: Would you like a slice of bread?
example_usage_vi: Bạn có muốn một lát bánh mì không?
usage_note: Bread is uncountable; use a loaf or slice for a countable amount.

en_definition: to damage something into pieces, or a short period of rest
example_meaning_en: Be careful not to break the glass.
example_meaning_vi: Hãy cẩn thận đừng làm vỡ chiếc ly.
example_usage_en: Let's take a short break after this lesson.
example_usage_vi: Hãy nghỉ giải lao ngắn sau bài học này.
usage_note: Break is a verb; take a break uses it as a countable noun.

en_definition: the first meal of the day
example_meaning_en: Breakfast is ready.
example_meaning_vi: Bữa sáng đã sẵn sàng.
example_usage_en: I usually have breakfast at seven.
example_usage_vi: Tôi thường ăn sáng lúc bảy giờ.
usage_note: Use have breakfast without an article for the daily meal.

en_definition: to take someone or something with you to a place
example_meaning_en: Please bring your book to class.
example_meaning_vi: Vui lòng mang sách đến lớp.
example_usage_en: Can I bring a friend with me?
example_usage_vi: Tôi có thể dẫn theo một người bạn không?
usage_note: Bring moves something toward the speaker or destination; take often moves it away.

en_definition: a male person who has the same parents as you
example_meaning_en: My brother is younger than me.
example_meaning_vi: Em trai tôi nhỏ tuổi hơn tôi.
example_usage_en: I share a room with my brother.
example_usage_vi: Tôi ở chung phòng với anh trai.
usage_note: Brother is countable.

en_definition: the color of earth or wood, or having that color
example_meaning_en: She has brown eyes.
example_meaning_vi: Cô ấy có đôi mắt nâu.
example_usage_en: Brown goes well with blue.
example_usage_vi: Màu nâu hợp với màu xanh dương.
usage_note: Brown can be an adjective or a noun naming the color.

en_definition: to make a structure by putting parts together
example_meaning_en: They plan to build a new school.
example_meaning_vi: Họ dự định xây một ngôi trường mới.
example_usage_en: The children built a house out of boxes.
example_usage_vi: Bọn trẻ dựng một ngôi nhà bằng các hộp giấy.
usage_note: Build something out of a material means use that material to make it.

en_definition: a structure with walls and a roof
example_meaning_en: That tall building is a hotel.
example_meaning_vi: Tòa nhà cao đó là một khách sạn.
example_usage_en: The office is on the second floor of the building.
example_usage_vi: Văn phòng ở tầng hai của tòa nhà.
usage_note: Building is countable.

en_definition: a large road vehicle that carries many passengers
example_meaning_en: The bus is late today.
example_meaning_vi: Xe buýt hôm nay đến muộn.
example_usage_en: I go to work by bus.
example_usage_vi: Tôi đi làm bằng xe buýt.
usage_note: Travel by bus, but get on or off the bus.

en_definition: the activity of buying and selling, or an organization that does this
example_meaning_en: Her family owns a small business.
example_meaning_vi: Gia đình cô ấy sở hữu một doanh nghiệp nhỏ.
example_usage_en: They do business with companies in Asia.
example_usage_vi: Họ làm ăn với các công ty ở châu Á.
usage_note: Do business with means have commercial relations with.

en_definition: having many things to do
example_meaning_en: I'm busy this afternoon.
example_meaning_vi: Tôi bận chiều nay.
example_usage_en: She is busy preparing for the exam.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy bận chuẩn bị cho kỳ thi.
usage_note: Use busy doing something, without with or to.

en_definition: used to introduce an idea that contrasts with the previous one
example_meaning_en: The room is small but comfortable.
example_meaning_vi: Căn phòng nhỏ nhưng thoải mái.
example_usage_en: I called him, but he did not answer.
example_usage_vi: Tôi gọi cho anh ấy nhưng anh ấy không trả lời.
usage_note: But joins contrasting words or clauses.

en_definition: a soft yellow food made from cream
example_meaning_en: Put some butter on the bread.
example_meaning_vi: Phết một ít bơ lên bánh mì.
example_usage_en: Melt the butter in a small pan.
example_usage_vi: Đun chảy bơ trong một chiếc chảo nhỏ.
usage_note: Butter is usually uncountable.

en_definition: to get something by paying money for it
example_meaning_en: I need to buy a new coat.
example_meaning_vi: Tôi cần mua một chiếc áo khoác mới.
example_usage_en: She bought the book for ten dollars.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy mua cuốn sách với giá mười đô-la.
usage_note: Buy something for an amount states its price.

en_definition: used to show the person doing something, the method, or a nearby position
example_meaning_en: The picture was painted by my aunt.
example_meaning_vi: Bức tranh được dì tôi vẽ.
example_usage_en: We traveled by train.
example_usage_vi: Chúng tôi đi bằng tàu hỏa.
usage_note: By can name the agent in a passive sentence or a method of travel.

en_definition: used when leaving someone
example_meaning_en: Bye! See you tomorrow.
example_meaning_vi: Tạm biệt! Hẹn gặp bạn ngày mai.
example_usage_en: She waved and said bye to everyone.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy vẫy tay và chào tạm biệt mọi người.
usage_note: Bye is informal; goodbye is more neutral.

en_definition: a small restaurant serving drinks and simple meals
example_meaning_en: Let's meet at the cafe.
example_meaning_vi: Hãy gặp nhau ở quán cà phê.
example_usage_en: We stopped for coffee at a nearby cafe.
example_usage_vi: Chúng tôi dừng lại uống cà phê tại một quán gần đó.
usage_note: Cafe is countable.

en_definition: a sweet baked food made from flour, eggs, sugar, and other ingredients
example_meaning_en: She made a chocolate cake.
example_meaning_vi: Cô ấy làm một chiếc bánh sô-cô-la.
example_usage_en: Would you like a piece of cake?
example_usage_vi: Bạn có muốn một miếng bánh không?
usage_note: Cake can be countable as a whole cake or uncountable as food.

en_definition: an act of speaking to someone by phone, or to contact them by phone or voice
example_meaning_en: I'll call you tonight.
example_meaning_vi: Tối nay tôi sẽ gọi cho bạn.
example_usage_en: Please give me a call when you arrive.
example_usage_vi: Vui lòng gọi cho tôi khi bạn đến.
usage_note: Call someone needs no preposition; give someone a call is a common noun phrase.

en_definition: a device used for taking photographs or recording video
example_meaning_en: This camera takes clear pictures.
example_meaning_vi: Máy ảnh này chụp hình rõ nét.
example_usage_en: She smiled at the camera.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy mỉm cười trước máy ảnh.
usage_note: Look or smile at the camera.

en_definition: used to say that someone is able or allowed to do something
example_meaning_en: I can swim.
example_meaning_vi: Tôi biết bơi.
example_usage_en: Can I open the window?
example_usage_vi: Tôi có thể mở cửa sổ không?
usage_note: Can is followed by the base form of a verb.

en_definition: used to say that someone is not able or allowed to do something
example_meaning_en: I cannot hear you.
example_meaning_vi: Tôi không thể nghe thấy bạn.
example_usage_en: You cannot park here.
example_usage_vi: Bạn không được đỗ xe ở đây.
usage_note: Cannot is one word; can't is its common short form.

en_definition: the main city of a country, most important, or written as a large letter
example_meaning_en: Hanoi is the capital of Vietnam.
example_meaning_vi: Hà Nội là thủ đô của Việt Nam.
example_usage_en: Begin every sentence with a capital letter.
example_usage_vi: Hãy bắt đầu mỗi câu bằng một chữ cái viết hoa.
usage_note: Capital is a noun for a city and an adjective in capital letter.

en_definition: a road vehicle with an engine, usually for a small number of people
example_meaning_en: Their car is parked outside.
example_meaning_vi: Xe của họ đậu bên ngoài.
example_usage_en: We traveled to the beach by car.
example_usage_vi: Chúng tôi đi đến bãi biển bằng xe hơi.
usage_note: Travel by car, but get into or out of a car.

en_definition: a small piece of plastic or stiff paper used for payment, identification, or messages
example_meaning_en: I paid with my card.
example_meaning_vi: Tôi thanh toán bằng thẻ.
example_usage_en: She sent me a birthday card.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy gửi cho tôi một tấm thiệp sinh nhật.
usage_note: Common compounds include credit card, ID card, and birthday card.

vi_meaning: sự nghiệp; nghề nghiệp lâu dài
en_definition: the series of jobs someone has during their working life
example_meaning_en: She wants a career in medicine.
example_meaning_vi: Cô ấy muốn theo đuổi sự nghiệp trong ngành y.
example_usage_en: He began his teaching career at 24.
example_usage_vi: Anh ấy bắt đầu sự nghiệp giảng dạy ở tuổi 24.
usage_note: Use a career in a field and begin a career.

en_definition: a long orange root vegetable
example_meaning_en: The rabbit is eating a carrot.
example_meaning_vi: Con thỏ đang ăn một củ cà rốt.
example_usage_en: Add some chopped carrots to the soup.
example_usage_vi: Thêm một ít cà rốt thái nhỏ vào súp.
usage_note: Carrot is countable; carrots can also refer to the food generally.

en_definition: to hold something and move it from one place to another
example_meaning_en: She carried the bag upstairs.
example_meaning_vi: Cô ấy xách chiếc túi lên tầng trên.
example_usage_en: This bus can carry 50 people.
example_usage_vi: Xe buýt này có thể chở 50 người.
usage_note: Carry can refer to holding things or transporting passengers.

en_definition: a small animal often kept as a pet
example_meaning_en: The cat is sleeping on the chair.
example_meaning_vi: Con mèo đang ngủ trên ghế.
example_usage_en: Our cat likes to play with boxes.
example_usage_vi: Con mèo của chúng tôi thích chơi với hộp.
usage_note: Cat is countable.

en_definition: a small plastic disc used to store music or computer data
example_meaning_en: This CD has ten songs.
example_meaning_vi: Đĩa CD này có mười bài hát.
example_usage_en: I listened to the album on CD.
example_usage_vi: Tôi nghe album bằng đĩa CD.
usage_note: CD is pronounced as two letters and is countable.

vi_meaning: xu; một phần một trăm của đô-la
en_definition: a unit of money equal to one hundredth of a dollar
example_meaning_en: The candy costs fifty cents.
example_meaning_vi: Viên kẹo có giá năm mươi xu.
example_usage_en: I found a one-cent coin.
example_usage_vi: Tôi tìm thấy một đồng xu một cent.
usage_note: Use cent after a number; the plural is cents.

en_definition: the middle point or main part of a place
example_meaning_en: There is a fountain in the center of the park.
example_meaning_vi: Có một đài phun nước ở trung tâm công viên.
example_usage_en: The hotel is close to the city center.
example_usage_vi: Khách sạn gần trung tâm thành phố.
usage_note: Use the center of a place; city center is a common compound.

en_definition: a piece of furniture for one person to sit on
example_meaning_en: Please sit on this chair.
example_meaning_vi: Vui lòng ngồi trên chiếc ghế này.
example_usage_en: He pulled up a chair beside me.
example_usage_vi: Anh ấy kéo một chiếc ghế đến cạnh tôi.
usage_note: Sit on a chair; pull up a chair means bring one closer.

en_definition: to become different or make something different
example_meaning_en: The weather can change quickly.
example_meaning_vi: Thời tiết có thể thay đổi nhanh chóng.
example_usage_en: We made a small change to the plan.
example_usage_vi: Chúng tôi thực hiện một thay đổi nhỏ trong kế hoạch.
usage_note: Change can be a verb; make a change uses it as a noun.

en_definition: a diagram that shows information in a clear visual form
example_meaning_en: The chart shows our monthly sales.
example_meaning_vi: Biểu đồ cho thấy doanh số hàng tháng.
example_usage_en: Look at the chart and compare the numbers.
example_usage_vi: Hãy nhìn biểu đồ và so sánh các con số.
usage_note: A chart can show numbers, changes, or categories.

en_definition: costing little money
example_meaning_en: This restaurant is good and cheap.
example_meaning_vi: Nhà hàng này ngon và rẻ.
example_usage_en: We found a cheap flight to Bangkok.
example_usage_vi: Chúng tôi tìm được một chuyến bay giá rẻ đến Bangkok.
usage_note: Cheap describes price, but can sound negative about quality in some contexts.

en_definition: to examine something to make sure it is correct or safe
example_meaning_en: Please check your answers.
example_meaning_vi: Vui lòng kiểm tra câu trả lời của bạn.
example_usage_en: Check that the door is locked.
example_usage_vi: Hãy kiểm tra xem cửa đã khóa chưa.
usage_note: Use check something or check that + clause.

en_definition: a food made from milk that can be soft or firm
example_meaning_en: There is cheese in the sandwich.
example_meaning_vi: Có phô mai trong chiếc bánh mì kẹp.
example_usage_en: I'd like a piece of cheese.
example_usage_vi: Tôi muốn một miếng phô mai.
usage_note: Cheese is usually uncountable; use a piece or slice for an amount.

en_definition: the meat from a chicken, or the farm bird itself
example_meaning_en: We had chicken and rice for dinner.
example_meaning_vi: Chúng tôi ăn thịt gà và cơm vào bữa tối.
example_usage_en: There are six chickens on the farm.
example_usage_vi: Có sáu con gà trong trang trại.
usage_note: Chicken is uncountable for meat and countable for the animal.

en_definition: a young person who is not yet an adult
example_meaning_en: The child is learning to read.
example_meaning_vi: Đứa trẻ đang học đọc.
example_usage_en: This ticket is free for children under five.
example_usage_vi: Vé này miễn phí cho trẻ em dưới năm tuổi.
usage_note: The irregular plural of child is children.

en_definition: a sweet brown food made from cocoa
example_meaning_en: She gave me some chocolate.
example_meaning_vi: Cô ấy cho tôi một ít sô-cô-la.
example_usage_en: He bought a box of chocolates.
example_usage_vi: Anh ấy mua một hộp kẹo sô-cô-la.
usage_note: Chocolate is uncountable as food; chocolates are individual pieces.

en_definition: to decide which person or thing you want
example_meaning_en: Choose a color for the wall.
example_meaning_vi: Hãy chọn một màu cho bức tường.
example_usage_en: You can choose between tea and coffee.
example_usage_vi: Bạn có thể chọn giữa trà và cà phê.
usage_note: Use choose between alternatives or choose to + verb.

en_definition: a large and important town
example_meaning_en: Ho Chi Minh City is very busy.
example_meaning_vi: Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh rất nhộn nhịp.
example_usage_en: They live in the city center.
example_usage_vi: Họ sống ở trung tâm thành phố.
usage_note: City is countable; the plural is cities.

en_definition: a group of students learning together, or a lesson
example_meaning_en: Our class begins at nine.
example_meaning_vi: Lớp của chúng tôi bắt đầu lúc chín giờ.
example_usage_en: She is taking an English class.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy đang học một lớp tiếng Anh.
usage_note: Take a class means attend a course or lesson.

en_definition: a room where students are taught
example_meaning_en: There are twenty desks in the classroom.
example_meaning_vi: Có hai mươi chiếc bàn trong phòng học.
example_usage_en: Please speak English in the classroom.
example_usage_vi: Vui lòng nói tiếng Anh trong lớp học.
usage_note: Use in the classroom for activity inside the room.

en_definition: not dirty, or to remove dirt
example_meaning_en: The kitchen is clean now.
example_meaning_vi: Nhà bếp bây giờ sạch rồi.
example_usage_en: Please clean the table after dinner.
example_usage_vi: Vui lòng lau bàn sau bữa tối.
usage_note: Clean can be an adjective or a verb.

en_definition: to move upward using your hands and feet
example_meaning_en: The children climbed the tree.
example_meaning_vi: Bọn trẻ trèo lên cây.
example_usage_en: We climbed up the hill slowly.
example_usage_vi: Chúng tôi từ từ leo lên đồi.
usage_note: Climb can take a direct object; climb up emphasizes upward movement.

en_definition: a device that shows the time and is not worn on the body
example_meaning_en: The clock says ten thirty.
example_meaning_vi: Đồng hồ chỉ mười giờ ba mươi.
example_usage_en: There is a clock on the wall.
example_usage_vi: Có một chiếc đồng hồ trên tường.
usage_note: A clock is not worn; a watch is worn on the wrist.

en_definition: to move something so that an opening is covered
example_meaning_en: Please close the window.
example_meaning_vi: Vui lòng đóng cửa sổ.
example_usage_en: The store closes at nine.
example_usage_vi: Cửa hàng đóng cửa lúc chín giờ.
usage_note: Close can take an object or describe a business ending service.

en_definition: the things people wear
example_meaning_en: Her clothes are in the closet.
example_meaning_vi: Quần áo của cô ấy ở trong tủ.
example_usage_en: I need some warm clothes for winter.
example_usage_vi: Tôi cần một ít quần áo ấm cho mùa đông.
usage_note: Clothes is plural and has no singular form.

en_definition: a group of people who meet for a shared activity
example_meaning_en: I joined the school music club.
example_meaning_vi: Tôi tham gia câu lạc bộ âm nhạc của trường.
example_usage_en: The club meets every Friday.
example_usage_vi: Câu lạc bộ gặp nhau vào mỗi thứ Sáu.
usage_note: Join a club means become a member.

en_definition: a piece of clothing worn over other clothes
example_meaning_en: Put on your coat; it is cold outside.
example_meaning_vi: Hãy mặc áo khoác; bên ngoài trời lạnh.
example_usage_en: She took off her coat at the door.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy cởi áo khoác ở cửa.
usage_note: Put on and take off are common verbs with coat.

en_definition: a dark drink made from roasted coffee beans
example_meaning_en: I drink coffee every morning.
example_meaning_vi: Tôi uống cà phê mỗi sáng.
example_usage_en: Can I have a cup of coffee?
example_usage_vi: Tôi có thể gọi một tách cà phê không?
usage_note: Coffee is uncountable; a coffee can mean one serving in informal use.

en_definition: having a low temperature, or a common minor illness
example_meaning_en: The water is too cold to swim in.
example_meaning_vi: Nước quá lạnh để bơi.
example_usage_en: I have a bad cold today.
example_usage_vi: Hôm nay tôi bị cảm nặng.
usage_note: Cold is an adjective for temperature; have a cold uses it as a noun.

en_definition: a place where students study after high school
example_meaning_en: She studies art at college.
example_meaning_vi: Cô ấy học nghệ thuật ở trường cao đẳng.
example_usage_en: He is a college student in Boston.
example_usage_vi: Anh ấy là sinh viên đại học ở Boston.
usage_note: At college describes studying there; college student is a common compound.

en_definition: the quality that makes things look red, blue, green, and so on
example_meaning_en: What color is your car?
example_meaning_vi: Xe của bạn màu gì?
example_usage_en: The room needs a little more color.
example_usage_vi: Căn phòng cần thêm một chút màu sắc.
usage_note: Color is countable for a particular color and uncountable as a general quality.

en_definition: to move toward or arrive at a place or person
example_meaning_en: Come here, please.
example_meaning_vi: Lại đây nhé.
example_usage_en: Would you like to come with us?
example_usage_vi: Bạn có muốn đi cùng chúng tôi không?
usage_note: Come with someone means accompany them.

en_definition: happening often or found in many places
example_meaning_en: This is a common mistake.
example_meaning_vi: Đây là một lỗi phổ biến.
example_usage_en: It is common for shops to close early on Sunday.
example_usage_vi: Các cửa hàng đóng cửa sớm vào Chủ nhật là chuyện thường.
usage_note: Common for someone/something to do describes a usual situation.

en_definition: a business organization that sells goods or services
example_meaning_en: She works for a software company.
example_meaning_vi: Cô ấy làm việc cho một công ty phần mềm.
example_usage_en: The company employs 200 people.
example_usage_vi: Công ty sử dụng 200 người.
usage_note: Work for a company names your employer.

en_definition: to examine people or things to see how they are similar or different
example_meaning_en: Compare the two pictures.
example_meaning_vi: Hãy so sánh hai bức tranh.
example_usage_en: People often compare this city with New York.
example_usage_vi: Mọi người thường so sánh thành phố này với New York.
usage_note: Compare A with B is the common learner pattern.

en_definition: having every necessary part, or to finish something
example_meaning_en: The list is now complete.
example_meaning_vi: Danh sách bây giờ đã đầy đủ.
example_usage_en: Please complete the form before Friday.
example_usage_vi: Vui lòng hoàn thành biểu mẫu trước thứ Sáu.
usage_note: Complete can be an adjective or a verb.

en_definition: a machine that stores and processes information
example_meaning_en: My computer is very slow today.
example_meaning_vi: Máy tính của tôi hôm nay rất chậm.
example_usage_en: She uses a computer for work.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy sử dụng máy tính để làm việc.
usage_note: Use a computer for a purpose.

en_definition: a public performance of music
example_meaning_en: The concert starts at eight.
example_meaning_vi: Buổi hòa nhạc bắt đầu lúc tám giờ.
example_usage_en: We went to a rock concert last night.
example_usage_vi: Tối qua chúng tôi đi xem một buổi hòa nhạc rock.
usage_note: Go to a concert; a rock or classical concert describes the music.

en_definition: an informal talk between two or more people
example_meaning_en: We had a long conversation after dinner.
example_meaning_vi: Chúng tôi đã trò chuyện lâu sau bữa tối.
example_usage_en: She started a conversation with the new student.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy bắt chuyện với học sinh mới.
usage_note: Have a conversation and start a conversation with someone are common patterns.

en_definition: to prepare food using heat
example_meaning_en: I cook dinner every evening.
example_meaning_vi: Tôi nấu bữa tối mỗi tối.
example_usage_en: She cooked a meal for her family.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy nấu một bữa ăn cho gia đình.
usage_note: Cook something for someone states who receives the food.

en_definition: the activity of preparing food
example_meaning_en: Cooking takes time and practice.
example_meaning_vi: Nấu ăn cần thời gian và luyện tập.
example_usage_en: My brother does most of the cooking at home.
example_usage_vi: Anh trai tôi làm phần lớn việc nấu ăn ở nhà.
usage_note: Cooking is uncountable when it means the activity.

en_definition: pleasantly cold, or informally very good
example_meaning_en: The evening air is cool.
example_meaning_vi: Không khí buổi tối mát mẻ.
example_usage_en: That's a cool idea!
example_usage_vi: Đó là một ý tưởng tuyệt đấy!
usage_note: Cool is informal when it means fashionable or excellent.

en_definition: accurate, or to remove an error
example_meaning_en: Your answer is correct.
example_meaning_vi: Câu trả lời của bạn đúng.
example_usage_en: Please correct the spelling mistake.
example_usage_vi: Vui lòng sửa lỗi chính tả.
usage_note: Correct can be an adjective or a verb.

en_definition: the amount paid for something, or to have a particular price
example_meaning_en: The total cost was fifty dollars.
example_meaning_vi: Tổng chi phí là năm mươi đô-la.
example_usage_en: How much does the ticket cost?
example_usage_vi: Vé có giá bao nhiêu?
usage_note: Cost is a noun; as a verb it does not use do twice beyond the question helper.

en_definition: used to express past ability, possibility, or a polite request
example_meaning_en: I could swim when I was five.
example_meaning_vi: Tôi đã biết bơi khi năm tuổi.
example_usage_en: Could you open the door, please?
example_usage_vi: Bạn có thể mở cửa giúp tôi được không?
usage_note: Could is followed by the base verb and often makes requests more polite.

en_definition: a nation with its own government and borders
example_meaning_en: Vietnam is a beautiful country.
example_meaning_vi: Việt Nam là một đất nước xinh đẹp.
example_usage_en: She moved to another country for work.
example_usage_vi: Cô ấy chuyển đến một nước khác để làm việc.
usage_note: Country is countable for a nation; the country can also mean rural land.

en_definition: a series of lessons in a subject
example_meaning_en: I'm taking an English course.
example_meaning_vi: Tôi đang học một khóa tiếng Anh.
example_usage_en: The course lasts for ten weeks.
example_usage_vi: Khóa học kéo dài mười tuần.
usage_note: Take a course means study it; a course in a subject names the field.

en_definition: a child of your aunt or uncle
example_meaning_en: My cousin lives in Da Nang.
example_meaning_vi: Anh họ tôi sống ở Đà Nẵng.
example_usage_en: I spent the weekend with my cousins.
example_usage_vi: Tôi dành cuối tuần với các anh chị em họ.
usage_note: Cousin does not show gender; add male or female only when necessary.

en_definition: a large farm animal kept for milk or meat
example_meaning_en: The cow is eating grass.
example_meaning_vi: Con bò đang ăn cỏ.
example_usage_en: This farm has twenty dairy cows.
example_usage_vi: Trang trại này có hai mươi con bò sữa.
usage_note: Cow is countable; dairy cow means a cow kept for milk.

en_definition: the thick fatty part of milk, or a soft substance used in food and cosmetics
example_meaning_en: She put cream in her coffee.
example_meaning_vi: Cô ấy cho kem sữa vào cà phê.
example_usage_en: The cake has chocolate cream on top.
example_usage_vi: Chiếc bánh có lớp kem sô-cô-la ở trên.
usage_note: Cream is usually uncountable.

en_definition: to make something new
example_meaning_en: The activity helped create a friendly atmosphere.
example_meaning_vi: Hoạt động giúp tạo ra bầu không khí thân thiện.
example_usage_en: You can create an account in a few minutes.
example_usage_vi: Bạn có thể tạo một tài khoản trong vài phút.
usage_note: Create is followed directly by the thing made.

en_definition: the ideas, customs, and way of life of a group of people
example_meaning_en: Food is an important part of culture.
example_meaning_vi: Ẩm thực là một phần quan trọng của văn hóa.
example_usage_en: The course teaches students about Japanese culture.
example_usage_vi: Khóa học dạy học sinh về văn hóa Nhật Bản.
usage_note: Use the culture of a group or a named culture such as Japanese culture.

en_definition: a small container used for drinking
example_meaning_en: There is a cup on the table.
example_meaning_vi: Có một chiếc cốc trên bàn.
example_usage_en: Would you like a cup of tea?
example_usage_vi: Bạn có muốn một tách trà không?
usage_note: A cup of describes both the container and an amount of drink.
